terms_mid_term_break_valid.name: terms_mid_term_break_valid
terms_mid_term_break_valid.value:
("terms"."mid_term_break_starts_on" IS NULL AND "terms"."mid_term_break_ends_on" IS NULL)
        OR ("terms"."mid_term_break_starts_on" >= "terms"."starts_on"
          AND "terms"."mid_term_break_ends_on" >= "terms"."mid_term_break_starts_on"
          AND "terms"."mid_term_break_ends_on" <= "terms"."ends_on")
